functions.name: nv::quaternion::mult_vec
functions.signature: template <class T> void nv::quaternion<T>::mult_vec(const nv::vec3<T> &src, nv::vec3<T> &dst) const
functions.description: Rotates a 3D vector by this quaternion, storing the result in dst. Conceptually computes v' = q * v * conjugate(q), where v is treated as a pure-imaginary quaternion. Use this overload to keep the source vector unchanged and write the rotated vector to a separate destination.
requirements: dst must be a valid reference to a nv::vec3<T> that can be written to.
This is a const operation on the quaternion; the quaternion object must be in a valid state.
For the operation to represent a pure rotation without scaling, the quaternion should be normalized (otherwise the result will be scaled).
All inputs should be finite numeric values compatible with type T.

Note: The provided implementation in the header uses 'src.v[i]' and 'dst.v[i]' member access, which do not exist in nv::vec3<T> as provided (fields are x,y,z or _array). This appears to be a bug in the header and may prevent compilation unless vec3<T> provides such members or the code is fixed.
